about.label: About the Lab
about.heading: Advancing software engineering education and research
about.p1: The Software Engineering Laboratory is an academic facility under the Department of Information Technology at Politeknik Negeri Malang, focused on software engineering and software development. The laboratory serves as a center for research, innovation, and community service oriented toward the advancement of software technology.
about.p2: Our activities span student competency development in software-based projects and competitions, fundamental and applied research, multi-disciplinary collaboration across health, education, economics, and other sectors, and community-facing implementation of research results.
about.institution: A research and development unit under the Department of Information Technology at Politeknik Negeri Malang.

vision.label: Vision
vision.text: To become a center of excellence in knowledge, technology, and software engineering innovation with global competitiveness, contributing meaningfully to academic, industry, and societal advancement.

privacy.label: Privacy Policy
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: The Software Engineering Laboratory ("SE Lab," "we," "us," or "our") operates this website (se.polinema.ac.id) as an academic resource. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect personal data when you visit our site, subscribe to our newsletter, register for events, or send us a message through the contact form.
privacy.dataCollectedIntro: We collect only the minimum personal data necessary to provide our services:
privacy.dataNewsletterItem: Newsletter subscription: Email address, preferred language, and optional interest categories (tutorials, events, publications, announcements). Stored in Supabase.
privacy.dataEventsItem: Event registration: Full name, email address, and a hashed password (for authentication). Registration records are linked to your account. Stored in Supabase.
privacy.dataContactItem: Contact form: Name, email address, subject, and message. Messages are sent via your email client (mailto); we do not store contact form submissions on our servers.
privacy.dataAutoItem: Automatically collected: Standard web-server access logs (IP address, browser type, referring page, timestamp) may be collected by our hosting provider (GitHub Pages) for operational purposes. We do not run our own analytics platform.
privacy.purpose1: We process personal data on the basis of consent (for newsletters and event registration) and legitimate interest (for responding to contact messages and maintaining service security).
privacy.purpose2: You may withdraw consent at any time by unsubscribing from newsletters (one-click link in every email) or by contacting us to request account and data deletion.
privacy.storageText: Personal data is stored in Supabase, a cloud database platform hosted in the Southeast Asia (Singapore) region. Supabase provides encryption at rest and in transit. We do not transfer personal data to additional third-party data processors beyond what is described in this policy.
privacy.retentionText: We retain personal data only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected. Newsletter subscriber emails are kept until you unsubscribe. Event registration records are kept for the duration of the event plus a reasonable archival period for attendance records (typically 1 academic year). You may request earlier deletion at any time.
privacy.thirdPartyIntro: Our site uses the following third-party services that may independently process data:
privacy.thirdPartyGoogleMaps: Google Maps (embedded iframe): Displayed on the Contact page to show our location. Google may collect usage data according to its own privacy policy. The map is loaded only after you grant consent via our cookie banner.
privacy.thirdPartyGoogleFonts: Google Fonts: We load fonts from fonts.googleapis.com for consistent typography. Google may log font requests.
privacy.thirdPartyGitHub: GitHub: Links to our GitHub organization (github.com/se-polinema). Clicking these links navigates to GitHub's site.
privacy.thirdPartySupabase: Supabase: Provides authentication and database services for newsletter subscriptions and event registration.
privacy.rightAccess: Access the personal data we hold about you
privacy.rightCorrection: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
privacy.rightDeletion: Request deletion of your personal data
privacy.rightWithdraw: Withdraw consent at any time (unsubscribe from newsletters, or contact us to delete your account)
privacy.rightComplaint: Lodge a complaint with a relevant data protection authority
privacy.rightsExercise: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at the email address below. We will respond within 30 days.
privacy.cookiesIntro: This site uses minimal cookies and browser storage for essential functionality:
privacy.cookiesLang: Language preference: stored in localStorage to remember your selected language (en/id). No consent required.
privacy.cookiesTheme: Theme preference: stored in localStorage to remember your dark/light mode choice. No consent required.
privacy.cookiesConsent: Consent preference: stored in localStorage to remember your data-consent choice. No consent required.
privacy.cookiesAuth: Authentication session: Supabase sets a session token cookie when you sign in for event registration. Essential for the service to function.
privacy.cookiesNoTracking: We do not use advertising cookies, third-party tracking cookies, or analytics cookies.
privacy.contactText: For questions about this Privacy Policy or to exercise your data rights, contact the lab coordinator:
privacy.contactAffiliation: Software Engineering Laboratory, Jurusan Teknologi Informasi, Politeknik Negeri Malang, Jl. Soekarno Hatta No.9, Malang, East Java, Indonesia 65141

cookieConsent.message: This site uses localStorage for language and theme preferences, and Supabase for newsletter subscriptions and event registration. Google Maps loads only after consent. See our Privacy Policy for details.
